description: Blocks a SUBAGENT (agent_id present) from BACKGROUNDING a long-running process: the `review` CLI, a `--watch` flag, a build/test suite (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/deno test|build, pytest/vitest/jest/cypress/playwright, cargo/go test|build, make/rake/msbuild test|build|all, mvn/gradle test|build|verify|package), or `sleep N` with N>=10. Backgrounding = the CC Bash `run_in_background: true` flag, a standalone `&` operator (NOT `&&`; a `&` fused into `2>&1` is ignored), or `setsid`. A subagent is NOT re-invoked by a background-completion notification (only the main loop is), so backgrounding a long process and ending the turn wedges the worker forever with uncommitted work and no PR (agent-tools#52). The inverse of no-long-inline-process: the orchestrator delegates long work to a backgrounded subagent; a subagent runs its OWN long work FOREGROUND and blocks. Argv-aware: a keyword inside a quoted argument to a different command never trips it. Subagent-ONLY (the orchestrator is allowed — its discipline is no-long-inline-process). Escape hatch: ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BACKGROUND=1 + ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BACKGROUND_REASON='why', or inline `# subagent-bg-ok: why`. on_error=open.
